GST Registration.shortDescription: Complete assistance for obtaining GST registration with application preparation, verification, and certificate issuance.
GST Registration.longDescription: We handle the entire GST registration process — assessing eligibility, preparing documentation, submitting Form REG-01, and resolving departmental queries — so your GSTIN is issued without delay.
benefits: Legally collect GST and claim ITC

process.title: Eligibility Check
process.description: Assess registration category and threshold.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit REG-01 with required documents.

process.title: GSTIN Issuance
process.description: Respond to queries and receive GSTIN.

faqs.question: What is the turnover threshold for GST?
faqs.answer: ₹40 lakh for goods and ₹20 lakh for services, subject to state variations.

faqs.question: Can I register in multiple states?
faqs.answer: Yes, a separate GSTIN is needed for each state of operation.

faqs.question: How long does GSTIN allotment take?
faqs.answer: Typically 5-7 working days if documents are in order.

GST Registration Amendment.shortDescription: Update business details, address, bank accounts, partners, or signatories in your existing GST registration.
GST Registration Amendment.longDescription: GST registration amendment keeps your GSTIN records accurate after any change in business particulars. We prepare and file the amendment application and track approval with the department.
features: Core and non-core field amendment filing
benefits: Keeps GST records accurate and compliant

process.title: Change Identification
process.description: Identify core vs non-core amendment fields.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit amendment application with proofs.

process.title: Approval Tracking
process.description: Follow up until amendment is approved.

faqs.question: What is a core field amendment?
faqs.answer: Changes like business name, address, or partners requiring officer approval.

faqs.question: Are non-core changes approved instantly?
faqs.answer: Yes, most non-core changes auto-update on the portal.

faqs.question: Is there a time limit to amend?
faqs.answer: Amendments should be filed within 15 days of the change.

GST Registration Cancellation.shortDescription: Surrender your GST registration with proper application filing and final compliance closure.
GST Registration Cancellation.longDescription: GST cancellation is needed when a business closes, transfers, or falls below threshold. We prepare the cancellation application, handle final return filing requirements, and address departmental queries.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit cancellation request with reason.

process.title: Final Return
process.description: File GSTR-10 final return.

process.title: Cancellation Order
process.description: Receive cancellation confirmation.

faqs.question: Is a final return mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, GSTR-10 must be filed within 3 months of cancellation.

faqs.question: Can cancellation be reversed?
faqs.answer: Yes, through a revocation application within the permitted period.

faqs.question: Are pending liabilities cleared automatically?
faqs.answer: No, outstanding tax and returns must be settled before cancellation.

GST Registration Revocation.shortDescription: Restore a cancelled GST registration by filing a revocation application with supporting documents.
GST Registration Revocation.longDescription: When GST registration is cancelled by the department, revocation allows restoration if the taxpayer complies with pending requirements. We prepare the application and represent before the officer if needed.

process.title: Compliance Review
process.description: Clear pending returns and dues causing cancellation.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit revocation application with justification.

process.title: Approval
process.description: Respond to queries and secure restoration.

faqs.question: What is the time limit for revocation?
faqs.answer: Generally within 90 days of cancellation, subject to extensions.

faqs.question: Must all pending returns be filed first?
faqs.answer: Yes, before the revocation application is considered.

faqs.question: Can revocation be rejected?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the officer isn't satisfied with the compliance shown.

GSTR-1 Filing.shortDescription: Accurate preparation and filing of outward supply details in GSTR-1 with invoice-level reconciliation.
GSTR-1 Filing.longDescription: GSTR-1 reports all outward supplies made during the period. We reconcile sales invoices, prepare the return, and ensure it aligns with your books before filing.
benefits: Ensures accurate ITC flow to buyers

process.title: Data Collection
process.description: Gather sales and invoice data for the period.

process.title: Reconciliation
process.description: Match invoices with books and classify supplies.

process.title: Filing
process.description: Submit GSTR-1 and confirm acknowledgment.

faqs.question: What is the due date for GSTR-1?
faqs.answer: 11th of the following month for monthly filers, quarterly under QRMP.

faqs.question: Can GSTR-1 be revised?
faqs.answer: No, corrections are made through amendments in a later period's return.

faqs.question: Is nil filing required if no sales?
faqs.answer: Yes, a nil GSTR-1 must still be filed.

GSTR-3B Filing.shortDescription: Monthly or quarterly summary GST return filing covering tax liability, ITC, and payment.
GSTR-3B Filing.longDescription: GSTR-3B is the self-declared summary return for tax payment. We compute liability, apply eligible ITC, and file the return accurately and on time.
benefits: Avoids interest on delayed tax payment

process.title: Data Compilation
process.description: Gather sales, purchase, and ITC data.

process.title: Liability Computation
process.description: Calculate net tax payable after ITC.

process.title: Filing & Payment
process.description: Pay tax and file the return.

faqs.question: What is the due date for GSTR-3B?
faqs.answer: 20th of the following month, staggered by state for smaller taxpayers.

faqs.question: Can I claim ITC not reflected in GSTR-2B?
faqs.answer: Generally no; ITC is now largely restricted to GSTR-2B-matched credit.

faqs.question: Is late fee applicable on nil returns?
faqs.answer: Yes, though at a reduced rate compared to regular returns.

GSTR-9 Annual Return.shortDescription: Preparation and filing of the annual GST return consolidating turnover, tax, and ITC information.
GSTR-9 Annual Return.longDescription: GSTR-9 consolidates the entire year's GST data reported across monthly/quarterly returns. We reconcile books with filed returns and prepare an accurate annual filing.
features: Turnover and tax reconciliation across the year

process.title: Data Reconciliation
process.description: Match books with filed monthly returns.

process.title: Return Preparation
process.description: Compile turnover, tax, and ITC summaries.

process.title: Filing
process.description: Submit GSTR-9 on the portal.

faqs.question: Who must file GSTR-9?
faqs.answer: Regular taxpayers above the prescribed turnover threshold.

faqs.question: Is GSTR-9 optional for small taxpayers?
faqs.answer: Filing is optional below a specified turnover limit in certain years.

faqs.question: What is the due date?
faqs.answer: 31st December following the end of the financial year.

GSTR-9C Reconciliation.shortDescription: Prepare the GST reconciliation statement comparing books, returns, and tax liability with explanations.
GSTR-9C Reconciliation.longDescription: GSTR-9C reconciles audited financial statements with annual GST returns, requiring detailed explanations for any variance. We prepare the reconciliation and certify it as applicable.
features: Tax liability and ITC variance analysis
benefits: Identifies unclaimed ITC or short payments

process.title: Data Compilation
process.description: Gather financials and filed GST returns.

process.title: Reconciliation
process.description: Compare turnover, tax, and ITC figures.

process.title: Certification & Filing
process.description: Finalize and file GSTR-9C.

faqs.question: Who needs to file GSTR-9C?
faqs.answer: Taxpayers above the turnover threshold prescribed for reconciliation statements.

faqs.question: Is self-certification allowed?
faqs.answer: Yes, self-certification has replaced mandatory CA certification currently.

faqs.question: What if there's a turnover mismatch?
faqs.answer: Reasons must be explained and, if needed, additional tax paid.

GSTR-4 Filing.shortDescription: Preparation and filing of annual returns for composition taxpayers based on turnover and tax paid.
GSTR-4 Filing.longDescription: GSTR-4 is the annual return for composition scheme taxpayers. We compile quarterly CMP-08 payments and turnover data to file an accurate annual return.
benefits: Simplified annual compliance for composition dealers

process.title: Data Compilation
process.description: Gather CMP-08 filings and turnover data.

process.title: Return Preparation
process.description: Prepare annual return with consolidated figures.

process.title: Filing
process.description: Submit GSTR-4 on the portal.

faqs.question: Who files GSTR-4?
faqs.answer: Taxpayers registered under the composition scheme.

faqs.question: What is the due date?
faqs.answer: 30th April following the end of the financial year.

faqs.question: Is CMP-08 different from GSTR-4?
faqs.answer: Yes, CMP-08 is quarterly tax payment; GSTR-4 is the annual return.

GST Nil Return Filing.shortDescription: Hassle-free filing of zero-liability GST returns when there are no taxable transactions.
GST Nil Return Filing.longDescription: Even with no sales or purchases, GST returns must be filed to avoid penalties. We handle nil GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B filing quickly and accurately.

process.title: Status Verification
process.description: Confirm no taxable transactions occurred.

process.title: Filing
process.description: File nil GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.

process.title: Acknowledgment
process.description: Share filing acknowledgment for records.

faqs.question: Is nil filing mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, even with zero activity, returns must be filed each period.

faqs.question: Can nil returns be filed via SMS?
faqs.answer: Yes, GSTR-3B nil filing is possible via SMS for eligible taxpayers.

faqs.question: Is there a penalty for missing nil returns?
faqs.answer: Yes, late fees apply even for nil returns.

GST E-Invoice Registration.shortDescription: Enable e-invoicing for your business with eligibility verification and portal registration support.
GST E-Invoice Registration.longDescription: E-invoicing is mandatory beyond a prescribed turnover threshold. We verify eligibility, register on the Invoice Registration Portal, and configure your systems for compliant invoice generation.
benefits: Ensures compliant invoicing from day one

process.title: Eligibility Check
process.description: Confirm applicability based on turnover.

process.title: Portal Registration
process.description: Register on the e-invoice/IRP portal.

process.title: System Setup
process.description: Configure and test invoice generation.

faqs.question: Who needs e-invoicing?
faqs.answer: Businesses above the notified turnover threshold for B2B supplies.

faqs.question: Is e-invoicing required for B2C?
faqs.answer: No, currently it applies mainly to B2B and export invoices.

faqs.question: What is an IRN?
faqs.answer: A unique Invoice Reference Number generated upon successful e-invoice validation.

E-Invoice Generation.shortDescription: Generate and validate GST-compliant electronic invoices with all required details.
E-Invoice Generation.longDescription: We generate e-invoices containing accurate supplier, recipient, tax, and transaction details, ensuring successful IRN generation and QR code compliance.

process.title: Data Preparation
process.description: Compile invoice details per schema.

process.title: IRP Submission
process.description: Submit to the Invoice Registration Portal.

process.title: IRN Delivery
process.description: Receive validated invoice with IRN and QR code.

faqs.question: Can an e-invoice be edited after IRN generation?
faqs.answer: No, it must be cancelled and a fresh invoice generated.

faqs.question: Is a QR code mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, for invoices under the e-invoicing mandate.

faqs.question: What happens if data doesn't match GSTR-1?
faqs.answer: E-invoice data auto-populates GSTR-1, reducing mismatch risk.

E-Invoice Cancellation.shortDescription: Cancel incorrect or duplicate e-invoices within the prescribed timeline while keeping records accurate.
E-Invoice Cancellation.longDescription: E-invoices with errors or duplication must be cancelled within 24 hours on the IRP. We manage the cancellation process and ensure your books and GST records stay consistent.
requirements: IRN of the invoice to cancel

process.title: Error Review
process.description: Confirm the invoice needs cancellation.

process.title: IRP Cancellation
process.description: Cancel the e-invoice within 24 hours.

process.title: Reissuance
process.description: Generate a corrected invoice if needed.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation window?
faqs.answer: 24 hours from IRN generation.

faqs.question: Can a partially used invoice be cancelled?
faqs.answer: No, only fully cancellable if not reported in a filed return.

faqs.question: What if the 24-hour window is missed?
faqs.answer: A credit note must be issued instead of cancellation.

E-Way Bill Registration.shortDescription: Register and configure the e-way bill system for compliant electronic transportation documentation.
E-Way Bill Registration.longDescription: Businesses transporting goods above prescribed value thresholds need e-way bill registration. We handle portal registration and configuration for smooth bill generation.

process.title: Portal Registration
process.description: Register business on the e-way bill portal.

process.title: User Setup
process.description: Create users and sub-users as needed.

process.title: Configuration
process.description: Set up bulk/API generation if applicable.

faqs.question: When is an e-way bill required?
faqs.answer: For movement of goods valued above ₹50,000 in most cases.

faqs.question: Is registration separate from GST registration?
faqs.answer: Yes, a separate one-time e-way bill portal registration is needed.

faqs.question: Can transporters generate e-way bills?
faqs.answer: Yes, after obtaining a Transporter ID.

E-Way Bill Generation.shortDescription: Generate compliant e-way bills with accurate invoice, transporter, and vehicle details.
E-Way Bill Generation.longDescription: We prepare and generate e-way bills for your consignments, ensuring correct details on goods, distance, and vehicle to avoid transit issues.

process.title: Data Entry
process.description: Enter invoice and transport details.

process.title: Bill Generation
process.description: Generate e-way bill with unique EWB number.

process.title: Documentation
process.description: Share e-way bill copy for transit.

faqs.question: How is validity calculated?
faqs.answer: Based on distance to be covered, roughly one day per 200 km.

faqs.question: Can vehicle number be updated later?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the vehicle changes during transit.

faqs.question: Is e-way bill needed for intra-state moves?
faqs.answer: Yes, for most states above the value threshold, with some exceptions.

E-Way Bill Modification.shortDescription: Correct permissible e-way bill details to keep transportation records accurate and compliant.
E-Way Bill Modification.longDescription: Certain e-way bill fields like vehicle number can be updated after generation. We manage the modification process to prevent transit disruptions.
benefits: Avoids transit delays from incorrect data

process.title: Detail Review
process.description: Identify the field requiring modification.

process.title: Update Filing
process.description: Update Part-B or permissible fields on the portal.

process.title: Confirmation
process.description: Confirm updated e-way bill.

faqs.question: What fields can be modified?
faqs.answer: Primarily vehicle number and transporter details via Part-B updates.

faqs.question: Can invoice value be changed?
faqs.answer: No, core invoice details require cancellation and reissue.

faqs.question: Is there a time limit for modification?
faqs.answer: Updates must be made before expiry of the e-way bill validity.

E-Way Bill Extension.shortDescription: Extend e-way bill validity when transportation cannot be completed within the original period.
E-Way Bill Extension.longDescription: Delays such as vehicle breakdown or natural events may require extending e-way bill validity. We handle the extension request with appropriate justification.
benefits: Avoids penalty for expired e-way bills

process.title: Eligibility Check
process.description: Confirm extension window (before/after expiry).

process.title: Extension Filing
process.description: Submit extension with reason and location.

process.title: Confirmation
process.description: Receive updated validity period.

faqs.question: Can extension be requested after expiry?
faqs.answer: Yes, within a limited window (typically 8 hours) after expiry.

faqs.question: What reasons qualify for extension?
faqs.answer: Natural calamity, law and order issues, or vehicle breakdown, among others.

faqs.question: Is extension automatic?
faqs.answer: No, it requires manual filing with justification on the portal.

HSN/SAC Classification.shortDescription: Identify accurate HSN or SAC codes for your products or services to apply correct GST rates.
HSN/SAC Classification.longDescription: Incorrect classification leads to wrong tax rates and compliance risk. We analyze your products/services against the HSN/SAC structure and notifications to determine accurate codes.

process.title: Product Review
process.description: Analyze product/service specifications.

process.title: Classification Mapping
process.description: Map to correct HSN/SAC and applicable rate.

process.title: Documentation
process.description: Provide classification report for reference.

faqs.question: Is HSN mandatory on invoices?
faqs.answer: Yes, based on turnover-linked digit requirements.

faqs.question: What if classification is later disputed?
faqs.answer: Documented rationale helps defend the position before authorities.

faqs.question: Do rates change with classification?
faqs.answer: Yes, different HSN/SAC codes can attract different GST rates.

GST Rate Advisory.shortDescription: Determine the correct applicable GST rate for your goods or services after reviewing classification and notifications.
GST Rate Advisory.longDescription: GST rates depend on classification, exemptions, and specific notifications. We provide advisory backed by current rate schedules and case-specific analysis.
requirements: Current rate being applied, if any

process.title: Case Review
process.description: Understand the product/service and transaction context.

process.title: Rate Analysis
process.description: Analyze applicable notifications and exemptions.

process.title: Advisory Delivery
process.description: Provide written rate advisory.

faqs.question: How often do GST rates change?
faqs.answer: Rates are revised periodically via GST Council notifications.

faqs.question: Can advisory be relied upon in disputes?
faqs.answer: It provides a documented basis, though final determination rests with authorities/courts.

faqs.question: Are exemptions common?
faqs.answer: Yes, several goods/services are wholly or partly exempt from GST.

ITC Reconciliation.shortDescription: Reconcile purchase records with GSTR-2B to identify eligible, missing, or blocked input tax credits.
ITC Reconciliation.longDescription: ITC reconciliation ensures you claim all eligible credit while avoiding blocked or duplicate claims. We match your purchase register against GSTR-2B and flag discrepancies for follow-up.
benefits: Reduces risk of credit reversal notices

process.title: Data Collection
process.description: Gather purchase records and GSTR-2B.

process.title: Reconciliation
process.description: Match records and identify differences.

process.title: Reporting
process.description: Share reconciliation report and action items.

faqs.question: Why do mismatches occur?
faqs.answer: Vendor non-filing, wrong GSTIN, or reporting period differences.

faqs.question: What if a vendor hasn't filed?
faqs.answer: Credit stays unavailable until the vendor files their return.

faqs.question: How often should reconciliation be done?
faqs.answer: Ideally every month before filing GSTR-3B.

GSTR-2B Reconciliation.shortDescription: Detailed comparison of GSTR-2B with purchase records to identify mismatches and ensure accurate ITC claims.
GSTR-2B Reconciliation.longDescription: We perform a line-by-line comparison of GSTR-2B against your books to catch supplier errors, timing differences, and missing invoices before you file.
benefits: Prevents excess or ineligible ITC claims

process.title: Data Extraction
process.description: Extract GSTR-2B and purchase data.

process.title: Matching
process.description: Compare invoice-wise details.

process.title: Report Delivery
process.description: Provide mismatch report with recommendations.

faqs.question: How is GSTR-2B different from GSTR-2A?
faqs.answer: GSTR-2B is a static monthly statement, while GSTR-2A updates dynamically.

faqs.question: Can ITC be claimed without matching?
faqs.answer: It carries higher risk and is generally not advisable.

faqs.question: What should I do with unmatched invoices?
faqs.answer: Follow up with the vendor to ensure timely filing.

ITC Reversal.shortDescription: Calculate and document input tax credit reversals arising from ineligible credits or exempt supplies.
ITC Reversal.longDescription: Certain circumstances require reversing previously claimed ITC. We compute the correct reversal amount and ensure proper reporting in returns.
benefits: Avoids future notices for excess ITC

process.title: Trigger Identification
process.description: Identify reason requiring reversal.

process.title: Calculation
process.description: Compute reversal amount and interest.

process.title: Reporting
process.description: Report reversal in GSTR-3B.

faqs.question: When is ITC reversal required?
faqs.answer: For exempt supplies, non-payment within 180 days, or personal use, among others.

faqs.question: Is interest payable on reversal?
faqs.answer: Yes, in specific cases like delayed payment to vendors.

faqs.question: Can reversed ITC be reclaimed later?
faqs.answer: Yes, once the triggering condition (e.g., payment) is resolved.

ITC Reclaim Assistance.shortDescription: Identify previously reversed eligible credits and reclaim them correctly once conditions are satisfied.
ITC Reclaim Assistance.longDescription: Once the reason for reversal (like delayed payment) is resolved, eligible ITC can be reclaimed. We track such credits and ensure timely, correct reclaiming.

process.title: Ledger Review
process.description: Identify previously reversed eligible credits.

process.title: Condition Verification
process.description: Confirm fulfilment of reclaim conditions.

process.title: Reclaim Filing
process.description: Report reclaim in the applicable return.

faqs.question: Is there a time limit to reclaim?
faqs.answer: Yes, generally tied to the annual return filing deadline.

faqs.question: What proof is needed for reclaim?
faqs.answer: Evidence that the original reversal condition, like payment, is now satisfied.

faqs.question: Can reclaimed ITC be audited?
faqs.answer: Yes, so documentation must be maintained carefully.

GST Refund Application.shortDescription: Prepare and file GST refund applications with reconciliation, documentation, and follow-up.
GST Refund Application.longDescription: GST refunds arise from excess payment, inverted duty, or exports. We prepare accurate refund applications with supporting statements and follow up until sanction.
benefits: Reduces processing delays through accurate filing

process.title: Eligibility & Category Review
process.description: Determine refund type and eligible amount.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: File RFD-01 with statements and documents.

process.title: Processing & Sanction
process.description: Respond to queries and track sanction.

faqs.question: What is the time limit to claim refund?
faqs.answer: Generally two years from the relevant date.

faqs.question: Is refund processing time-bound?
faqs.answer: Yes, officers are required to process within 60 days, with interest for delays.

faqs.question: Can partial refund be sanctioned?
faqs.answer: Yes, if only part of the claim is found eligible.

Export GST Refund.shortDescription: Claim eligible GST refunds on exports with complete documentation and departmental coordination.
Export GST Refund.longDescription: Exporters can claim refund of accumulated ITC or IGST paid on exports. We manage documentation, reconciliation, and application filing for smooth refund processing.
features: Export invoice and shipping bill reconciliation

process.title: Documentation Review
process.description: Reconcile export invoices with shipping bills.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: File refund application on the portal.

process.title: Follow-up & Sanction
process.description: Track processing and secure refund.

faqs.question: What are the two export refund routes?
faqs.answer: Export under LUT without tax payment, or export on IGST payment followed by refund.

faqs.question: Is a Bank Realization Certificate required?
faqs.answer: It supports the claim though not always mandatory upfront.

faqs.question: What causes refund delays?
faqs.answer: Data mismatches between GST returns and shipping bill/customs records.

LUT Filing.shortDescription: File your Letter of Undertaking to export goods or services without payment of IGST.
LUT Filing.longDescription: LUT filing allows eligible exporters to supply without upfront IGST payment, improving cash flow. We prepare and submit the LUT application annually.

process.title: Eligibility Check
process.description: Confirm no prosecution or tax evasion history.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit RFD-11 on the GST portal.

process.title: Acknowledgment
process.description: Receive LUT acknowledgment for the financial year.

faqs.question: How often must LUT be filed?
faqs.answer: Every financial year before commencing exports.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for LUT?
faqs.answer: Exporters without conviction for tax evasion above a specified amount.

faqs.question: What if LUT isn't filed?
faqs.answer: Exports must be made on IGST payment followed by refund claim.

Inverted Duty Refund.shortDescription: Calculate and claim refunds arising from accumulated credit under the inverted duty structure.
Inverted Duty Refund.longDescription: When input tax rates exceed output tax rates, accumulated ITC can be refunded. We calculate eligible refund and manage the application process.
benefits: Improved cash flow for affected businesses
requirements: Input and output tax rate details

process.title: Eligibility Assessment
process.description: Confirm inverted duty structure applicability.

process.title: Refund Calculation
process.description: Compute refund as per prescribed formula.

process.title: Application & Follow-up
process.description: File and track refund application.

faqs.question: What is inverted duty structure?
faqs.answer: When GST rate on inputs is higher than on output supplies.

faqs.question: Are all sectors eligible?
faqs.answer: Certain goods are excluded from this refund by notification.

faqs.question: Is input services credit refundable?
faqs.answer: No, only credit on inputs is considered under this refund.

GST Notice Reply.shortDescription: Professional preparation of responses to GST notices after reviewing allegations, records, and evidence.
GST Notice Reply.longDescription: GST notices require timely, well-documented responses to avoid adverse orders. We review the notice, gather supporting records, and draft a comprehensive reply.

process.title: Notice Analysis
process.description: Understand allegations and required response.

process.title: Reply Preparation
process.description: Draft reply with supporting evidence.

process.title: Submission
process.description: File reply within the stipulated deadline.

faqs.question: What happens if a notice is ignored?
faqs.answer: The department may pass an ex-parte adverse order.

faqs.question: Can the deadline be extended?
faqs.answer: Extensions may be requested but are at the officer's discretion.

faqs.question: Is personal hearing required?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, depending on the nature and complexity of the notice.

DRC-01 Notice Reply.shortDescription: Respond to demand-related GST notices with detailed analysis of tax calculations and supporting evidence.
DRC-01 Notice Reply.longDescription: DRC-01 notices propose tax demands that require careful analysis and rebuttal where incorrect. We review the demand basis and prepare a substantiated reply.
benefits: Structured documentation for appeal, if needed

process.title: Demand Analysis
process.description: Review the basis of the proposed demand.

process.title: Reply Drafting
process.description: Prepare detailed reply with evidence.

process.title: Submission & Hearing
process.description: File reply and attend hearing, if scheduled.

faqs.question: What is DRC-01?
faqs.answer: A summary of the show-cause notice proposing GST demand.

faqs.question: What is the reply deadline?
faqs.answer: Typically 30 days from notice issuance, unless specified otherwise.

faqs.question: What if the demand is confirmed?
faqs.answer: An appeal can be filed before the appellate authority.

GST Assessment Assistance.shortDescription: Representation and compliance support during GST assessment proceedings before tax authorities.
GST Assessment Assistance.longDescription: GST assessments require detailed documentation and clear explanations. We assist with record preparation, reconciliations, and representation throughout the proceedings.

process.title: Case Review
process.description: Understand scope and issues of assessment.

process.title: Documentation
process.description: Prepare reconciliations and submissions.

process.title: Representation
process.description: Attend hearings and respond to queries.

faqs.question: What triggers a GST assessment?
faqs.answer: Return discrepancies, non-filing, or risk-based selection.

faqs.question: Can I appeal an assessment order?
faqs.answer: Yes, before the appellate authority within the prescribed time.

faqs.question: Is legal representation allowed?
faqs.answer: Yes, an authorized representative can appear on your behalf.

GST Audit Assistance.shortDescription: Comprehensive support during GST audits including records preparation and departmental communication.
GST Audit Assistance.longDescription: GST audits examine returns, records, and compliance in detail. We prepare requested documents, reconcile data, and coordinate with auditors for a smooth process.
requirements: Books of accounts and GST returns

process.title: Scope Review
process.description: Understand audit period and focus areas.

process.title: Document Preparation
process.description: Compile records and reconciliations requested.

process.title: Audit Support
process.description: Coordinate meetings and respond to observations.

faqs.question: Who conducts GST audit?
faqs.answer: Departmental officers under Section 65, or special audit under Section 66.

faqs.question: How long does an audit take?
faqs.answer: Typically completed within 3 months, extendable by 6 months.

faqs.question: What follows an audit?
faqs.answer: An audit report is issued, which may lead to demand proceedings.

GST Appeal Filing.shortDescription: Prepare and file GST appeals against assessment orders, demands, or penalties.
GST Appeal Filing.longDescription: When a GST order is unfavorable, an appeal preserves your right to challenge it. We draft grounds of appeal, compile evidence, and file within statutory timelines.
benefits: Preserves right to challenge adverse orders

process.title: Order Review
process.description: Analyze the order and identify appeal grounds.

process.title: Appeal Drafting
process.description: Prepare appeal memorandum and supporting documents.

process.title: Filing
process.description: File appeal with pre-deposit payment.

faqs.question: What is the time limit to file appeal?
faqs.answer: Generally three months from communication of the order.

faqs.question: Is pre-deposit mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, a specified percentage of the disputed tax must be deposited.

faqs.question: Can a second appeal be filed?
faqs.answer: Yes, before the GST Appellate Tribunal if unsatisfied with the first order.

GST TDS Registration.shortDescription: Register for GST TDS compliance if your entity is required to deduct tax under GST provisions.
GST TDS Registration.longDescription: Government departments and notified entities must deduct GST TDS on specified payments. We manage registration and set up processes for compliant deduction and deposit.

process.title: Applicability Check
process.description: Confirm entity falls under TDS deductor category.

process.title: Registration Filing
process.description: Register for GST TDS on the portal.

process.title: Process Setup
process.description: Establish deduction and deposit workflow.

faqs.question: Who must deduct GST TDS?
faqs.answer: Government departments and notified entities on contracts above ₹2.5 lakh.

faqs.question: What is the TDS rate under GST?
faqs.answer: 2% (1% each CGST/SGST or 2% IGST) on payment value.

faqs.question: Is separate registration required?
faqs.answer: Yes, distinct from regular GST registration.

GST TDS Return Filing.shortDescription: Prepare and file GST TDS returns with accurate deduction, supplier, and deposit details.
GST TDS Return Filing.longDescription: GSTR-7 reports TDS deducted under GST along with deposit and deductee details. We ensure accurate, timely filing to enable supplier credit.
benefits: Avoids late fee for TDS returns

process.title: Data Compilation
process.description: Gather deduction and payment records.

process.title: Return Preparation
process.description: Prepare GSTR-7 with deductee details.

process.title: Filing
process.description: Submit return and generate TDS certificates.

faqs.question: What is the due date for GSTR-7?
faqs.answer: 10th of the following month.

faqs.question: Does the deductee get automatic credit?
faqs.answer: Yes, TDS credit reflects in the deductee's electronic cash ledger.

faqs.question: Is nil filing needed if no deduction?
faqs.answer: No, GSTR-7 is required only when TDS is deducted.

GST TCS Compliance.shortDescription: Ensure GST TCS compliance for e-commerce operators covering collection, reporting, and reconciliation.
GST TCS Compliance.longDescription: E-commerce operators must collect TCS on supplies made through their platform. We manage collection computation, GSTR-8 filing, and reconciliation with suppliers.

process.title: Applicability Review
process.description: Confirm TCS obligation as e-commerce operator.

process.title: Computation
process.description: Calculate TCS collectible per supplier.

process.title: Filing
process.description: File GSTR-8 with collection details.

faqs.question: Who is liable for GST TCS?
faqs.answer: E-commerce operators collecting payment on behalf of suppliers.

faqs.question: What is the TCS rate?
faqs.answer: 0.5% each under CGST and SGST (or 1% IGST) on net taxable supplies.

faqs.question: Can suppliers claim TCS credit?
faqs.answer: Yes, it reflects in their electronic cash ledger for use against tax liability.

RCM Compliance.shortDescription: Identify reverse-charge transactions, calculate liability, and claim eligible corresponding input tax credit.
RCM Compliance.longDescription: Reverse Charge Mechanism shifts tax payment liability to the recipient in specified cases. We identify applicable transactions, compute liability, and ensure correct ITC claim.
benefits: Avoids interest for missed RCM payment
Correct ITC availability on RCM tax paid

process.title: Transaction Review
process.description: Identify RCM-applicable purchases.

process.title: Liability Computation
process.description: Calculate tax payable under RCM.

process.title: Payment & ITC Claim
process.description: Pay RCM liability and claim eligible ITC.

faqs.question: What transactions attract RCM?
faqs.answer: Specified goods/services notified under Section 9(3)/9(4) of the CGST Act.

faqs.question: Can RCM tax be paid from ITC?
faqs.answer: No, it must be paid in cash and can then be claimed as ITC.

faqs.question: Is self-invoicing required?
faqs.answer: Yes, when procuring from an unregistered supplier under RCM.

GST Composition Scheme.shortDescription: Assess eligibility and register under the composition scheme for simplified tax compliance.
GST Composition Scheme.longDescription: The composition scheme offers reduced compliance and flat-rate taxation for eligible small taxpayers. We assess eligibility, manage registration, and explain applicable restrictions.
benefits: Reduced tax outflow for eligible businesses

process.title: Eligibility Check
process.description: Assess turnover and business-type eligibility.

process.title: Opt-in Filing
process.description: File CMP-02 to opt for the scheme.

process.title: Compliance Guidance
process.description: Explain restrictions and quarterly obligations.

faqs.question: What is the turnover limit for composition?
faqs.answer: ₹1.5 crore for goods (₹75 lakh for special category states); ₹50 lakh for services.

faqs.question: Can composition dealers claim ITC?
faqs.answer: No, ITC cannot be claimed under the composition scheme.

faqs.question: Can composition dealers make inter-state sales?
faqs.answer: No, inter-state outward supply is not permitted.

Composition Return Filing.shortDescription: Prepare and file applicable returns for composition taxpayers based on turnover and tax liability.
Composition Return Filing.longDescription: Composition taxpayers file quarterly CMP-08 statements and annual GSTR-4. We ensure accurate computation and timely filing throughout the year.
benefits: Accurate tax computation at flat rates
requirements: Tax rate applicable to business type

process.title: Turnover Compilation
process.description: Gather quarterly sales data.

process.title: Tax Computation
process.description: Calculate tax at applicable composition rate.

process.title: Filing
process.description: File CMP-08 or GSTR-4 as applicable.

faqs.question: What is CMP-08?
faqs.answer: A quarterly statement for composition taxpayers to pay tax.

faqs.question: Is GSTR-4 separate from CMP-08?
faqs.answer: Yes, GSTR-4 is the annual return consolidating all quarters.

faqs.question: What is the due date for CMP-08?
faqs.answer: 18th of the month following the quarter.

GST Compliance Audit.shortDescription: Comprehensive review of GST registrations, invoices, returns, and reconciliations to identify compliance risks.
GST Compliance Audit.longDescription: A proactive GST compliance audit identifies gaps before they attract departmental scrutiny. We review your entire GST process and provide a risk report with corrective steps.
requirements: GST returns for the review period

process.title: Scope Definition
process.description: Define audit period and focus areas.

process.title: Detailed Review
process.description: Examine returns, invoices, and reconciliations.

process.title: Report Delivery
process.description: Present findings and recommendations.

faqs.question: How often should a GST audit be done?
faqs.answer: Ideally annually, or before major transactions/expansions.

faqs.question: Is this different from statutory GST audit?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is an internal review, not a departmental requirement.

faqs.question: What does the report include?
faqs.answer: Identified risks, quantified exposure, and corrective action steps.

GST Health Check.shortDescription: Detailed review of GST processes and documentation to identify compliance gaps and improvement opportunities.
GST Health Check.longDescription: A GST health check examines your transactions, returns, and processes holistically, surfacing risks and opportunities for improved efficiency and compliance.

process.title: Process Mapping
process.description: Understand current GST processes and controls.

process.title: Review
process.description: Examine returns, ITC, and documentation.

process.title: Recommendations
process.description: Deliver findings and improvement plan.

faqs.question: How is this different from a compliance audit?
faqs.answer: It's broader, also covering process efficiency, not just compliance risk.

faqs.question: Who should get a health check?
faqs.answer: Growing businesses or those with frequent GST queries/notices.

faqs.question: How often is it recommended?
faqs.answer: Annually or after major business changes.

Sales vs GSTR-1 Reconciliation.shortDescription: Reconcile accounting sales with GSTR-1 to identify omitted invoices, duplicates, and mismatches.
Sales vs GSTR-1 Reconciliation.longDescription: Discrepancies between books and GSTR-1 can trigger notices. We reconcile sales ledgers with filed GSTR-1 data and highlight corrections needed.

process.title: Data Extraction
process.description: Extract sales and GSTR-1 data for the period.

process.title: Reconciliation
process.description: Match invoices and identify discrepancies.

process.title: Reporting
process.description: Share reconciliation report and corrections needed.

faqs.question: Why do sales and GSTR-1 differ?
faqs.answer: Timing differences, omitted invoices, or classification errors.

faqs.question: Can differences be corrected later?
faqs.answer: Yes, via amendments in subsequent period's GSTR-1.

faqs.question: How often should this be done?
faqs.answer: Monthly, ideally before filing GSTR-3B.

GSTR-1 vs GSTR-3B Reconciliation.shortDescription: Compare outward supplies and tax liability reported in GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B to identify differences.
GSTR-1 vs GSTR-3B Reconciliation.longDescription: Mismatches between GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B are a common audit trigger. We reconcile both returns and flag differences requiring correction or explanation.
features: Turnover and tax comparison across returns
requirements: Filed GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B for the period

process.title: Data Compilation
process.description: Gather both returns for the review period.

process.title: Comparison
process.description: Compare turnover and tax figures.

process.title: Reporting
process.description: Provide variance report and correction plan.

faqs.question: Why do these two returns often differ?
faqs.answer: GSTR-1 reports invoice-level data while GSTR-3B is a summary, leading to timing gaps.

faqs.question: Can a mismatch trigger a notice?
faqs.answer: Yes, significant unexplained differences often trigger scrutiny.

faqs.question: How is a variance resolved?
faqs.answer: Through amendment in the next period or a documented explanation.

Books vs GST Returns Reconciliation.shortDescription: Reconcile financial books with GST returns to identify turnover, tax, and reporting differences.
Books vs GST Returns Reconciliation.longDescription: This year-round reconciliation ensures your books and GST filings stay aligned, reducing surprises at year-end annual return time.
requirements: All GST returns for the period

process.title: Data Compilation
process.description: Gather books and filed return data.

process.title: Reconciliation
process.description: Match turnover, tax, and ITC figures.

process.title: Reporting
process.description: Provide reconciliation statement and corrections.

faqs.question: How often should this reconciliation be done?
faqs.answer: Quarterly is recommended, mandatory review before annual return.

faqs.question: What causes book-return mismatches?
faqs.answer: Timing differences, classification errors, or omitted entries.

faqs.question: Does this help with GSTR-9C?
faqs.answer: Yes, it forms the foundation for accurate GSTR-9C preparation.

E-Invoice vs Books Reconciliation.shortDescription: Compare e-invoice records with accounting books to identify missing entries and discrepancies.
E-Invoice vs Books Reconciliation.longDescription: We reconcile IRN-generated e-invoices against your accounting records to catch missing invoices, duplicate entries, and value mismatches before filing.

process.title: Data Extraction
process.description: Extract IRN and books data for the period.

process.title: Matching
process.description: Compare records and identify gaps.

process.title: Correction Support
process.description: Recommend fixes for identified issues.

faqs.question: Why might e-invoices not match books?
faqs.answer: Manual entries bypassing IRP, or timing differences in recording.

faqs.question: Can missing e-invoices be generated later?
faqs.answer: Yes, but ideally as close to the transaction date as possible.

faqs.question: Does this affect GSTR-1 accuracy?
faqs.answer: Yes, since e-invoice data auto-populates GSTR-1.

E-Way Bill vs Sales Reconciliation.shortDescription: Reconcile e-way bills with sales records to identify transportation mismatches and missing documents.
E-Way Bill vs Sales Reconciliation.longDescription: Mismatches between e-way bills and sales invoices can indicate compliance gaps. We reconcile both to ensure consistent, defensible records.
features: E-way bill vs sales invoice matching

process.title: Data Compilation
process.description: Gather e-way bill and sales data.

process.title: Reconciliation
process.description: Match records and identify gaps.

process.title: Reporting
process.description: Provide findings and corrective guidance.

faqs.question: Why reconcile e-way bills with sales?
faqs.answer: To ensure all dispatches are properly invoiced and reported.

faqs.question: Can this reveal unbilled sales?
faqs.answer: Yes, movements without corresponding invoices may surface.

faqs.question: Is this useful during audits?
faqs.answer: Yes, it strengthens documentation for logistics-related queries.

Import GST Compliance.shortDescription: Ensure GST compliance for imported goods covering IGST, input credit, and documentation.
Import GST Compliance.longDescription: Imports attract IGST at customs, with eligible input credit available to the importer. We manage documentation, credit tracking, and accounting treatment.
benefits: Ensures full eligible ITC claim on imports

process.title: Document Review
process.description: Review Bill of Entry and IGST paid.

process.title: ITC Reconciliation
process.description: Match ICEGATE data with GSTR-2B.

process.title: Reporting
process.description: Ensure accurate claim and accounting entries.

faqs.question: Is IGST on imports available as ITC?
faqs.answer: Yes, subject to normal ITC eligibility conditions.

faqs.question: Does Bill of Entry reflect in GSTR-2B?
faqs.answer: Yes, IGST paid on imports auto-populates from ICEGATE.

faqs.question: Are customs duties like BCD creditable?
faqs.answer: No, only IGST and applicable cess are available as GST credit.

Import of Services GST.shortDescription: Ensure reverse-charge GST compliance on imported services including tax payment and credit claim.
Import of Services GST.longDescription: Import of services attracts GST under reverse charge, payable by the recipient. We compute liability, ensure payment, and support eligible ITC claims.
benefits: Ensures compliance on cross-border service imports
Avoids interest for missed RCM payment

process.title: Transaction Identification
process.description: Confirm import of service and RCM applicability.

process.title: Liability Computation
process.description: Calculate GST payable under RCM.

process.title: Payment & ITC Claim
process.description: Pay tax and claim eligible credit.

faqs.question: Is import of service always taxable?
faqs.answer: Generally yes, except specified exemptions like personal use imports.

faqs.question: Who pays the GST on imported services?
faqs.answer: The Indian recipient, under reverse charge.

faqs.question: Can this GST be claimed as ITC?
faqs.answer: Yes, if used for business purposes and conditions are met.

Export GST Compliance.shortDescription: Complete GST compliance support for exporters covering LUT, invoicing, returns, and refunds.
Export GST Compliance.longDescription: Exporters need coordinated compliance across LUT filing, invoicing, e-invoicing, returns, and refunds. We manage the entire cycle to ensure smooth, compliant export operations.
benefits: Improved cash flow through timely refunds

process.title: Compliance Mapping
process.description: Assess LUT, invoicing, and reporting needs.

process.title: Return & Documentation
process.description: Ensure accurate zero-rated reporting.

process.title: Refund Coordination
process.description: Track and follow up on eligible refunds.

faqs.question: Are exports taxable under GST?
faqs.answer: Exports are zero-rated, meaning no GST is charged but ITC/refund is available.

faqs.question: Is LUT mandatory for all exporters?
faqs.answer: It's optional but preferred over paying IGST and claiming refund.

faqs.question: How are export supplies reported?
faqs.answer: Under the zero-rated supply section of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.

Job Work GST Compliance.shortDescription: Advisory and compliance support for job-work transactions covering documentation and input tax credit.
Job Work GST Compliance.longDescription: Job work involves specific GST documentation for goods sent and received. We manage challans, time-limit tracking, and return reporting for compliant job-work operations.
benefits: Ensures compliant movement of goods for job work
Proper ITC tracking on inputs sent

process.title: Transaction Review
process.description: Understand job work flow and documentation needs.

process.title: Challan & ITC-04 Filing
process.description: Prepare challans and file ITC-04.

process.title: Time-limit Monitoring
process.description: Track return timelines to avoid deemed supply.

faqs.question: What is ITC-04?
faqs.answer: A statement reporting goods sent to and received from job workers.

faqs.question: What happens if goods aren't returned in time?
faqs.answer: It is treated as a deemed supply, attracting GST.

faqs.question: Can a job worker claim ITC on his own inputs?
faqs.answer: Yes, on inputs/services he independently procures for the job work.

Works Contract GST.shortDescription: GST advisory for works contracts covering classification, rates, ITC, and place of supply.
Works Contract GST.longDescription: Works contracts are treated as a composite supply of service under GST with specific rate and ITC rules. We provide advisory on classification, invoicing, and compliance.
requirements: Nature of work and materials involved

process.title: Contract Review
process.description: Analyze scope and nature of the works contract.

process.title: Classification & Rate
process.description: Determine GST rate and place of supply.

process.title: Advisory Delivery
process.description: Provide compliance and invoicing guidance.

faqs.question: Is works contract treated as goods or service?
faqs.answer: It is treated as a supply of service under GST.

faqs.question: Can ITC be claimed on works contract services?
faqs.answer: Restricted in many cases, especially for immovable property construction.

faqs.question: How is place of supply determined?
faqs.answer: Generally the location of the immovable property for construction-related contracts.
